documents.title: Maximum load constraint
documents.text: The sum of roll weights assigned to one carrier must not exceed max_weight_kg. Single roll weight must also be no greater than the carrier limit.

documents.title: Maximum stacking height
documents.text: The computed stack envelope, including support material, must stay within max_height_mm before a plan is released.

documents.title: Mixed batch isolation
documents.text: When allow_mixed_batch is false, rolls from different batches must be partitioned before solver dispatch and validated independently.

documents.title: Roll diameter clearance
documents.text: Roll diameter and clearance determine candidate placement geometry. Diameter is normalized to millimetres before solving.

documents.title: Load balance validation
documents.text: The independent validator checks center-of-mass deviation and rejects unstable layouts even when geometric utilization is high.

documents.title: Suspended packing route
documents.text: Suspended or hanging requests route to SUSPEND_FIRST; pallet requests route to PALLET_FIRST unless an explicit second-stage request is present.

documents.title: Queue service objectives
documents.text: Queue delay and solver duration are separate service indicators. Retry, dead-letter and lease-expiry rates are monitored by job type.
